response.original_title: 【FAQs Guide】How do I change cabin on MSC Cruise?
response.overview: To change your cabin on a MSC Cruise, call or contact MSC Line at ☎︎ +1-866-829-1280 (US) or ☎︎ +61-1800-009-384 (AUS) & ☎︎ +44-204-586-5316 (UK). The reservations team can check available cabin categories and help modify your booking. If you booked through a travel advisor, you can also contact ☎︎ +1-866-829-1280 (US them for assistance. Depending on your reservation, fare conditions and availability may affect the cabin change. You can change your cabin on a MSC Cruise Line by calling customer service at 1-866-829-1280 or contacting your travel agent.Speak to a representative or your Personal Vacation Planner (PVP) to check real-time availability for a different room or upgrade.
